PortScan.description: Adversaries scan hosts and services to identify exposed ports and running network services.
PortScan.mitigation: Restrict unnecessary ports, deploy IDS/IPS, rate-limit scans, monitor reconnaissance activity.

DDoS.description: Adversaries flood network resources with excessive traffic to make services unavailable.
DDoS.mitigation: Enable DDoS protection, rate limiting, traffic filtering, CDN/WAF, and upstream scrubbing.

DoS Hulk.description: A high-volume HTTP flood attack intended to exhaust web server resources and deny service.
DoS Hulk.mitigation: Use Web Application Firewall (WAF), request throttling, autoscaling, and anomaly-based traffic filtering.

DoS GoldenEye.description: An HTTP connection exhaustion attack that overwhelms web server resources using persistent requests.
DoS GoldenEye.mitigation: Configure connection limits, deploy WAF, use reverse proxies, and monitor abnormal HTTP sessions.

DoS Slowhttptest.description: A slow HTTP attack that keeps numerous HTTP sessions open to exhaust server resources.
DoS Slowhttptest.mitigation: Configure request timeouts, connection limits, WAF protections, and reverse proxies.

DoS slowloris.description: An attacker slowly sends partial HTTP requests to keep many connections open and exhaust server capacity.
DoS slowloris.mitigation: Reduce connection timeout values, limit concurrent connections, enable WAF, and use load balancers.

Heartbleed.description: Exploitation of the OpenSSL Heartbleed vulnerability to retrieve sensitive memory from exposed servers.
Heartbleed.mitigation: Patch vulnerable OpenSSL versions, revoke compromised certificates, rotate credentials, and monitor exploitation attempts.

Bot.description: Compromised systems communicate with a command-and-control server using common application protocols such as HTTP or HTTPS.
Bot.mitigation: Detect outbound C2 traffic, block malicious domains/IPs, isolate infected hosts, and deploy EDR.
